svg.title: Three Seats Launch; Five Seats Support the Scaled Case
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-three-to-five-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Three Seats Launch; Five Seats Support the Scaled Case; subtitle: Keep commercial authority, platform execution, and telecom operations explicit.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each numeric value represents one person, not one full-time equivalent. Conservative and Base use 1 FT + 2 C; Scaled uses 2 FT + 3 C. The last two seats are additions, not initial hires.; caption: Conservative: $150,000 gross, $97,500 retained, $27,000 owner profit; margins 18% gross and 27.69% retained. Base: $675,000 gross, $438,750 retained, $189,000 profit; margins 28.0% and 43.08%. Scaled: $1,200,000 gross, $780,000 retained, $456,000 profit; margins 38% and 58.46%. Retained share stays 65%.; stages: label: Owner and commercial lead; value: Initial full-time seat owns commitments and customer economics; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Set pricing floors, negotiate supplier rights, maintain cash forecasts, and resolve customer concentration exposure. Authorize commitment increases only after reviewing utilization, churn, and available operating cash.; label: Platform engineering contractor; value: Initial contractor owns routing, isolation, and usage integrity; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain LiteLLM or vLLM, tenant controls, DCGM collection, idempotent wallet debits, and usage reconciliation. Publish tested incident runbooks and instrument supplier-cost drift.; label: Telecom operations contractor; value: Initial contractor owns carrier provisioning and traffic exceptions; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain SIP least-cost routes, carrier limits, 10DLC provisioning records, traceback responses, and applicable filing calendars. Escalate suspicious traffic immediately rather than waiting for monthly settlement.; label: Customer operations specialist; value: Scaled addition supplies the second full-time operating seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own onboarding, support queues, renewal preparation, and service-credit evidence. Add this seat when measured support load threatens response targets and retained contribution can support the recurring expense.; label: Security and reconciliation contractor; value: Scaled addition supplies the third contracted specialist seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Independently sample access controls, supplier invoices, wallet balances, and abuse investigations. Separate reconciliation review from the person changing rates or issuing customer credits.
